entities.name: Antonio Cermeño

entities.summary: Antonio Cermeño was a Venezuelan professional boxer who competed from 1990 to 2006. He is a world champion in two weight classes, having held the World Boxing Association (WBA) super-bantamweight title from 1995 to 1997 and the WBA featherweight title from 1998 to 1999.
